items.title: Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag withdrawal/repayment decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Document dated 08.07.2026 (Wed); assuming Aufgabe zur Post the same day, Bekanntgabe fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is the 3rd day after mailing = 11.07.2026 (Saturday). Since that falls on a Saturday, Bekanntgabe shifts to the next Werktag = Monday 13.07.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist is an Ereignisfrist: per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Bekanntgabe (13.07.) is not counted, the period starts 14.07.2026; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 13.08.2026 (Thursday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so it remains the final day (§ 193 BGB not needed).
